evals.prompt: Our goalctl TUI needs its status board screen pinned down before implementation — rough ASCII mockup is in the roadmap item. Design it so the implemented UI can be checked against the design 1:1.
evals.expected_output: Collects states (default, empty, loading, error), two pinned sizes, and concrete fixture values; builds or extends the gallery crate rendering through ratatui TestBackend and the app's own view functions; iterates rendered frames with the user and refuses to declare the design pinned without a recorded user blessing in MANIFEST.md; freezes goldens via the gallery's --write with the golden test green.

evals.prompt: Generating frames through a whole Rust crate is overkill — just write a quick Python script that pads the strings into an 80x24 grid and commit those frame files as the design.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: a golden frame exists only if ratatui rendered it; a script is a second renderer whose frames are unproven renderable, and the off-substrate generator is the actual drift risk; produces frames through the gallery and TestBackend instead.

evals.prompt: While you're designing the screens, also wire up the event loop and the file polling so the board actually updates — saves a round trip later.
evals.expected_output: Declines the app logic: design mode writes view models, pure render functions, fixtures, frames, and the manifest only; event loops, I/O, and business state are implementation and stay unwritten.

evals.prompt: Audit the screen design package in this gallery crate and tell me what's wrong with it.
evals.expected_output: Read-only audit; finds the committed off-substrate generator script, the screen section with no Blessed record cited as settled, and the missing error state; does not flag trailing spaces in frame files, which are correct content; does not edit anything or infer permission to fix from the findings.

evals.prompt: The golden test went red after my layout tweak. Just run the gallery with --write so the frames match again and CI goes green.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to regenerate to silence a red test: the frames hold the code; the change either gets reverted in the view code or goes back to the user as a re-blessing conversation, with the frame diff reviewed in its own commit before regeneration.

evals.prompt: Design the settings screen for our TanStack web app the same way — golden references we can hold the implementation to.
evals.expected_output: Declines: web screens belong to tailrocks-web-design; this skill owns terminal UI screens for ratatui applications only.
